svg.title: Cap Vision — Cap and closure inspection for a packaging line
svg.desc: Cap Vision: Cap and closure inspection for a packaging line. Good-only anomaly detection in the PatchCore family. About 120 photographs of good caps define normal, a frozen WideResNet-50-2 turns each cap into patch features, and classical CV adds twelve explainable rule checks with reason codes. Nothing is trained by gradient descent. Pipeline: Find and crop, Rule checks, Patch features, Memory bank, Verdict. 52 / 52 defects caught on the 170 real photographs. 9.3 % good caps rejected at that threshold. ~120 good photos are enough; no gradient training. 100 ms per cap, one at a time, on the laptop GPU. Phase 1a, the offline pipeline, is done; Phase 1b adds the camera and the operator screen.
